material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - the two sounds of THE
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll work on the word you repeat most often, and most often say the same way. It’s... …THE! Two forms, decided by the following sound: the end

Getting it right is invisible when correct and audible the moment it is wrong. There is a third use: stressed /ðiː/, when you mean THE one and only.
